tracks.title: Looking for a notebook in the study room

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: すみません。机の上にノートがありますか。
turns.english: Excuse me. Is there a notebook on the desk?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい、青いノートがあります。
turns.english: Yes, there is a blue notebook.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 赤いノートもありますか。
turns.english: Is there also a red notebook?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいえ、赤いノートはありません。
turns.english: No, there is no red notebook.

comprehensionPrompts: What object is on the desk?
What color is the notebook that is there?

tracks.title: Finding a person and a bag in the classroom

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 教室に先生がいますか。
turns.english: Is the teacher in the classroom?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 教室にかばんもありますか。
turns.english: Is there also a bag in the classroom?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: いいえ、かばんは教室にありません。廊下にあります。
turns.english: No, the bag is not in the classroom. It is in the hallway.

comprehensionPrompts: Is the bag in the classroom?
